headline: Public testimony taken on Nashua school facilities, possible closures, and redistricting under the Facility Master Plan.
summary: The hearing gathered community testimony and responses on school facilities, possible closures, redistricting, enrollment, and effects on students and neighborhoods. The minutes record no votes or decisions on these matters.

SPECIAL BOARD OF EDUCATION – PUBLIC HEARING 
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A special meeting of the Board of Education was held at NHS North on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.  Ms. Bishop 
called the meeting to order at 6:45 pm. 
 
Present: Ms. Giglio, Mr. Johnson, Ms. Raymond, Mr. Salvi, Ms. Lamphier, Ms. Lopez, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present: Dr. Andrade, Dr. Scarpati, Mr. O’Rourke, Mr. Smith, Lisa Sawin (Harriman) and Jamie Ouellette 
(Harriman) 
 
The purpose of this Special BOE Public Hearing - Facility Master Plan (Harriman). 
 
Opening and purpose 
Ms. Bishop called the Special Board of Education meeting to order and framed structure of a public hearing . The 
public hearing’s purpose is to gather community testimony and board responses on Nashua school facilities, possible 
closures, redistricting, enrollment, and the effects on students and neighborhoods.
